latest_release.name: NewTube 1.17.1 — Pepe Viyuela Edition
latest_release.body:
Unofficial YouTube client for Android phones and tablets, built on [SmartTube](https://github.com/yuliskov/SmartTube) by [@yuliskov](https://github.com/yuliskov).

### What's new

- **A video decoder that fails to start no longer lowers your quality for good.** NewTube used to recover by switching to 1080p AVC and saving it as your format, so every later video stayed capped. Now the fallback only applies to the video that failed. Thanks to SmartTube's fix ([#6326](https://github.com/yuliskov/SmartTube/issues/6326)).

### Download

| Phone | File |
| --- | --- |
| Most phones | `NewTube_1.17.1_arm64-v8a.apk` |
| Older 32-bit phones | `NewTube_1.17.1_armeabi-v7a.apk` |
| Not sure | `NewTube_1.17.1_universal.apk` |
| Older x86 devices | `NewTube_1.17.1_x86.apk` |

Android 7.0+. Installs over 1.17.0 and keeps your account and settings; 1.12.0 and later find it by themselves. [newtube.org](https://newtube.org/) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/aleixrodriala/newtube/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### Known issues

- Search with the keyboard open and the mini player showing leaves some empty space at the bottom.
- Some videos only play in YouTube's own app or after a purchase (paid movies, some music).

Signing certificate SHA-256: `2e:f9:9d:76:ed:fa:d9:88:ad:17:cd:ee:8b:a1:8c:63:4e:23:0f:e1:e3:cb:1f:dc:6c:db:02:49:37:0a:36:c9`. Checksums in `SHA256SUMS`; verify with `gh attestation verify <file>.apk -R aleixrodriala/newtube`.

*NewTube is not affiliated with Google, YouTube or SmartTube's developer.*
